description: Defines thresholds and rules for automated failover suggestions in wireless networks

stable.description: Network is stable, no action required

temporary_degradation.description: Temporary degradation detected, send alert and monitor closely

degrading.description: Network degrading - failover required to nearest healthy AP

likely_failure.description: Critical failure imminent - urgent failover required

decision_logic.description: Agent 3 provides suggestions only - no automated failover execution
decision_logic.fallback_strategy: If no suitable failover AP found, recommend manual investigation
